adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff introduces `group.users.delete(user_id)`. In Rails, `association.delete` removes join rows without instantiating/destroying the join model, so any `GroupUser`-level `destroy` callbacks (if they exist) would be skipped; using `destroy`/`destroy_all` would be required to guarantee callbacks run. However, the claim that a non-member `user_id` raises `RecordNotFound` is not supported by what’s shown here (typically `delete` just affects 0 rows), and the specific mentioned callbacks (“title and primary-group cleanup”) are not verifiable from this diff.
